title: The new need not justify everything

captions.energy: End an earlier form of participation

meaning: Your union can create a new form of life after an earlier one ends, even when emotional confidence returns more slowly than practical progress.
text: A new phase of shared life does not always bring an immediate sense of solid ground. In the physical position, the Empress sets creative actions: arranging, sustaining and nurturing what is available now. In energy, Death encourages you to finish an earlier form and release effort for a continuation. In emotions, the Tower describes upheaval as a familiar foundation falls away. Earlier certainty no longer works, while another has yet to develop. Your overall tone can be active and vulnerable at once, without proving the change mistaken or guaranteeing a welcome outcome.

For example, you abandon a familiar large celebration and arrange a small gathering. Everything receives care, but the missing scale suddenly feels like losing an earlier image of yourselves together. The new evening cannot immediately fill that space. **What you create now can be good even before familiar confidence returns.** One gathering need not establish the rightness of your whole direction or require identical enthusiasm from each of you. It can simply be an evening taking shape between you.

The difficulty appears if emotional upheaval must be removed through an even more decisive ending. You want to erase every trace of the past, accelerate new arrangements and leave no room for doubt. Trying to restore a foundation, you make the new form more fragile: it must justify everything immediately. A continuation can develop gradually without disappointment becoming a verdict on your union.
